title: Case REQ-20261109-LIF003 — insurer quotes
content:
Insurer comparison prepared by the Insurance Research Agent for Ivy (Insurance Research), case REQ-20261109-LIF003.

Cover quoted: buy-sell life and TPD of $1,200,000 on George Papadopoulos (52) and $1,200,000 on Harpreet Kaur (47), each owned by the life insured; key person life and TPD of $400,000 on George, owned by Northcote Custom Joinery Pty Ltd. Lyrebird Life doesn't offer business protection, so it wasn't quoted.

Year-1 stepped premiums at standard rates for all three covers:
• Northbank Life — $8,620 — recommended for Amelia's consideration: buy-sell and key person options designed for business owners, and fast financial underwriting
• Corella Life — $9,180
• Harbourline Life — $9,410

Northbank Life split (year 1, standard rates):
• George, buy-sell life and TPD $1,200,000 — $4,140
• George, key person life and TPD $400,000 — $1,380 (paid by the company)
• Harpreet, buy-sell life and TPD $1,200,000 — $3,100
Total: $8,620.

Second review: total cover on the case is $2,800,000, so Theo, the Practice Team Leader, reviewed the advice before the applications went to underwriting (a human approval).

Final premiums depend on underwriting — see 'Case REQ-20261109-LIF003 — underwriting decision'. Ivy's agent compares; Amelia decides what to recommend.
